definitions.explanation: An identification card issued by a school or university to its enrolled students. Used for identification, library access, student discounts, and exams.

examples.japanese: {学生証|がくせいしょう}を{見|み}せてください。
examples.english: Please show me your student ID.

examples.japanese: {学生証|がくせいしょう}があれば{割引|わりびき}が{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: If you have a student ID, you can get a discount.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{時|とき}は{必|かなら}ず{学生証|がくせいしょう}を{持参|じさん}してください。
examples.english: Please make sure to bring your student ID when taking exams.

notes:
A compound of {学生|がくせい} (student) and {証|しょう} (certificate, proof).

In Japan, {学生証|がくせいしょう} is essential for student discounts ({学割|がくわり}) on trains, museums, movies, and more. Students typically carry it at all times.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ} is a general ID document
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう} is an employee ID card

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学生証|がくせいしょう}を{提示|ていじ}する (to present one's student ID)
- {学生証|がくせいしょう}の{再発行|さいはっこう} (reissue of student ID)
- {学生証|がくせいしょう}を{紛失|ふんしつ}する (to lose one's student ID)
